notes.title: Join our team and develop the game community with us!

Hello everyone! 

We're happy to say that our community continues to grow and we've decided to look into the possibility of assigning few moderators for our Discord server!

[url=https://forms.gle/Lez3Vu8jcDonwpTd9][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/d9c7564fb32972ded1ae1bf21e86ab59d5dbe5fd.png[/img][/url]

We're increasing the number of garages available for you to buy and use! As you might have already notice using only one garage when dealing with multiple sales and purchases is a little bit problematic so very soon you'll have a chance to spread your wings and own more than just one garage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/cf2559e7f1d3e32511e319ea6f12be76fd1c90e1.png[/img]

Training Center will be the place where you'll be able to send your employees to gain some extra knowledge. It will take some time and you will have to pay a little for this particular convenience but as they say - knowledge is power! As you can see on the screenshot there's a chance that your employee will receive a lot of experience this way so it might be wise to try this particular service!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/c609f2e6fe82d4fa88b0e152fbc4ae0ec9426e1a.png[/img]

Car Dealerships will be a separate option for car sales. If you're not so much interested in talking with the customers you may simply drop your car at your Car Dealership and done, voila! It will definitely speed up the process of selling and make it possible for you to focus on bigger or more important sales!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/84b92de4ecd90ff3b8d47b384bd2184b70b56633.png[/img]

Docks will allow you a chance to gamble your hard-earned money - for set price and after waiting some time you'll receive a container that can have almost anything inside - great cars, horrible cars, nothing at all or just some scrap. It's your choice to use their services - sometimes they might help you with taking off with your business but sometimes they can shut you down hard. Be careful!

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #51 - "More about special events!"
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[h2]Many days ago we have talked with you about random game events - a special little occurrences in the daily life of car traders that spice them up. We would like to revisit it for a while.[/h2]

[b]As we have said previously there will be many random events in the game that will make each playthrough of the game a little bit different ensuring a replayability of the game. Random game events might be strictly positive, negative or they can be mixed - offering a little bit of advantage here, and a little bit of disadvantage there. The choice is ultimately yours.[/b]

Positive game events are especially fun since they provide you with an opportunity to gain something. What you'll be gaining will differ from event to another event but for the sake of example let's say that it's not just the cash that you'll get this way...
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/60e5c5eab35ad45717a95bb84f88f14c476915a1.jpg[/img]

Negative game events often have you face some problematic situation and will make sure to add that little extra spice for you. There's nothing more horrifying when you're already barely meeting ends and then it turns out that your cars were stolen or your garage burnt down... Maybe it's time for a loan?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/f7ffa6720e283206b5abb0e6a48de0ebeb3d394c.png[/img]

Mixed events combine both of those two aspects often leaving you with a choice where you'll be forced to make some compromises. See the example below - as you can see every choice brings something positive and negative to the table and depending on your needs and preferences you should make an appropriate choice. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/9e2761c2bf48f07f9b9ab7c3121e43c7007305aa.png[/img]

While very similar you need to differentiate between random game events and consequences of your choices. Let's say that you have sold a car without fixing or checking it altogether, you have lied to your customer saying it's absolutely fine and it does not require additional fixes. Don't be surprised if that customer calls you later to yell at you for lying! However that is not a random game event - it is merely a consequence of your actions.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/cbc1f71e41afeeee42edee7b8bae0f6ec75b2dc3.jpg[/img]

[b]Mechanics are very important people for car industry and any aspiring car trader should have at least few of them in their ranks. Without mechanics any car you get that is at least a little damaged will stay that way and surely that fact will got reflected on the face of your clients when they spot the fault.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/533853b3ca01e12aafa23dfe969a3a77fdc8b95f.jpg[/img]

As seen in the screenshot above you can make a selection regarding particular elements of the car that you would like to fix. If you prefer to sell some of your cars not in an entirely perfect condition - that is also a choice you can make. Maybe the customer will simply not ask and forget to check?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/ab58c28c83687c61beeda60784e1abbeec8b415b.png[/img]

[b]Mechanics are also invaluable if you would prefer to fix all cars but without spending a dime on it. As you have some contacts on local scrapyards you can send your mechanics there to check for any still working and usable components and use that scrap to repair the cars without using any of your hard earned cash. Make sure to find some time and send them to a scrapyard from time to time.[/b]

[i]Mechanics are your best friends! Take care of them and they will take care of you![/i]

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #47 - "Equipment"
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[h2]What is a mechanic without his wrench and tools? What is a thief without lockpicks? What is a driver without a car or a truck? In this devlog we will talk about equipment available for our employees![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/955dd260907718b70e92c9e4407fc9040681c280.png[/img]

[b]After hiring employees for your fledling car trading empire you will need to remember one thing - only that much can be achieved by your workers alone without proper equipment. 

There is no use getting angry with your thief for not outrunning police cars if he has no navigation system. A mechanic equipped with a whole toolset will achieve much more than one without them. That is why you might want to equip your employees with appropriate tools.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/ec34abd0f0a863e412644eb1aab88261930da8b9.jpg[/img]

[b]That of course means that you will have to pay for additional equipment but benefits can be easily seen in the appropriate menu (above you can see some of the tools you can buy for your drivers, on screenshots below you will have the chance to check equipment for other employees). 
Remember - you can buy equipment on the very same window where you hire your employees.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/224ac0c4b74bf190808dc0dc32b45d933c4aad95.jpg[/img]

[b]You quickly will be able to see the effect those tools will have on your workers. For example - your mechanic equipped with a big tool box will be quite faster with all repairs thus you will have quicker access to your cars and that $1500 you spent on the equipment will be back very soon![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/7bed342a7db7e60c0e1e1a8c9d64c967712423f2.jpg[/img]

[b]While some of the tools are really expensive they are also designed in a way to give you a huge boon to your work. Imagine - you only have to buy the three bed tow truck once and you will be able to transport three cars with one driver all the time. Unless they get into accident, of course... but let's not talk about that![/b]

[i]Remember to drag and drop the equipment on the appropriate employee for them to equip it![/i]

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator Devlog #46 - "Let me out!"
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Car Traders![/b][/h1]

[h2]In the last devlog we talked a bit about the usage of thieves and benefits you can receive when you use them correctly. But what if they get caught?[/h2]

[b]If you're very mindful of how you use your thieves it is quite possible that you will avoid being detected and caught. However police in the city can be very unpredictable and fast. What you thought is a great place to perform your not-so-legal activities might just turn out to be swarming with police officers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3b515191e4e92791c1cabd3bde517276f267aa23.jpg[/img]

[b]If your thief gets caught they are naturally send to prison and you lose some points on your lawfulness meter. Fortunately - that is not the end of the story for them as you can help them get out of the prison by bribing your way to their freedom. With appropriate amount of money a lot can be achieved and thief's name can be cleared of all charges. That is... if you decide to use your money. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/f43168f93528a2ed4ef0a4ff73b19feede2750c3.png[/img]

[b]Yet you might not always have the appropriate amount of cash or perhaps the thief that got caught has been known to get caught so often that you are simply fed up with him. If you decide to not pay for their crimes after some time the thief will get sentenced - this time meaning a very real end of his story.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/31af44ccff38eb06296f3380646261ce992baff8.jpg[/img]

[i]Make sure that you are not letting an experienced thief rot away in prison![/i]

[h1][b]Hello dear Car Trade Simulator fans![/b][/h1]

Company’s name and logo is very important in every business. There is no exception in the Car Trader Simulator!

[previewyoutube=R-kQ58ybMlE;full][/previewyoutube]

First off - logo.
Logo is what most people think of when they say the name of any company. We have some logos prepared - you can choose from many variants and shapes! It is also said that logos can be positive or negative in perception. In this example I chose a logo with a speedometer. Why? Because my company is going off quick, straight to the target! And the target is to make our customers happy! But it wouldn't be great, if we could add our own logo? Well - yes and you can!  In order to do that you must add your own logo to directory C:/users/username/documents/my games/Car Trader Simulator/ Logotypes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/4cfa0fa648d8b3335b43b3ae196cef8eabf87927.jpg[/img]

Next thing is the company's name. Both, logo and the name are connected and make one whole composition. Of course making a name for the company is not an easy task! This is harder than anyone would guess. In order to make life easier - we can wing it and try random names. Who knows? Maybe this little bit of chaos will be key to success? Of course, we can enter our own name for our company - we believe our players have their own great ideas for the company's name!

What are your thoughts? How would you name your company? What logo would you choose? Leave us a comment with your proposition!

notes.title: CTS Devlog #2 - Markets
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/d4e5d9d7054f8752e0df53e76c0b7040887c0cbc.jpg[/img]
What’s up gearheads?

This week we are taking a closer look at one of our core mechanics, which is buying cars.
In Car Trader Simulator, you will buy most of your cars on one of three markets;
Insurance auctions, E-buy, and Black Market.
Of course, each of those has its pros and cons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/dbd620d9606caeb9e786acfedab15be9d9a31d90.png[/img]Insurance auctions are usually a legit  source of used cars in good dissent prices. The only con is that they are usually very damaged, or even completely undriveable. So keep in mind that you need to add repair cost to the amount of your bid. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/9aee980ef1e1cdefd5519724ece4b1acda1a6834.png[/img]E-buy is an internet platform where people sell and buy various goods, including used cars. Those cars are usually legit, but you can never know whether a person selling a car is honest. Those are the most expensive, but usually from legal sources and in acceptable condition, so buying a car on E-buy platform is quite a safe choice.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/64cdd66c19983b15326995f8923b8ce27d65526d.png[/img]Cars from black market are the cheapest, but also very shady. You can never know whether a car was stolen (probably was), or repaired with third-party replacement parts(also, very likely). 
You can save a lot of money this way, but there is always a risk that the police will start asking questions, or enraged client will come for a refund because car broke down two days after the transaction. Every purchase on black market will reduce your righteousness (you know you are doing wrong, right? ;-P), and every refund call will decrease your reputation so if you want to be a righteous, respectable businessman and run your business clean, stay away from there!

Which source of vehicles is the best? Which company policy will you choose as the best path to the success? You decide!

See you next week! ;-)
Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: CTS Devlog #1 - How to win an auction?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/d4e5d9d7054f8752e0df53e76c0b7040887c0cbc.jpg[/img]
[h1]What's up, gearheads?[/h1]

Since the official release is coming soon, we've decided to start a devlog to keep you up to date with features of the game, and stay in touch with our community. 
This week we are taking a closer look at one of our core mechanics, which is bidding cars on auctions.

First thing you need to do is to find auction that seems interesting to you.
If it hasn’t begun yet, you'll need to wait for it to begin, so watch the timers, or you can miss an occasion! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/2b5db0877e1401151b1cc5f4e98979ff035f81e1.png[/img]

At the beginning the price may be very low, but remember that other salesmen also want to buy this car.
 
By clicking or holding a “+100” button you can name your price, then hit the button with a gavel icon to place the bid.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/b5a2a29a7af559d89f7e2d3c5d75f1e25d53a7e1.png[/img]
If your bid is currently the highest, bidding gauge will turn green. Analogically, if the gauge turns red again, it means you are outbid.  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/ffd139b678bb8697aeff6eccdbfa230d9cb882df.png[/img]
 The best practice for bidding is to watch how long the gauge will sustain before another trader outbids current offer. If the gauge is almost full, it means that other participants of the auction are not very willing to pay more than the current price. It is also the best moment to outdbid the price. However, you need to remember that if you pay too much, you can have big problems with selling the car with profit.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/8291176730fa68a6d4930b0bea6bbd2dcdced2ea.png[/img]
If you rather lean towards the casual side of play, on “easy” and “normal” difficulty level you will make use of “profitability gauge”, located on the right side of bidding panel, which indicates whether car is still worth fighting for.
The more the gauge leans towards the green field, the better the deal is. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31151725/4e53737ce29f04f10d32e442d0e84f254104f813.png[/img]
